_comment: navya-1b-av M1 RUN config (docs/14_navya_1b_av_plan.md) — audio CPT of the finished navya-1b 338M checkpoint on the A10, via train_av.py --init-from <navya-1b ckpt>. Model shape = navya-1b.json exactly (dim 1024 x 24, GQA 16/4, tied 64K). Mix: p_audio 0.35 ASR batches (Kathbath first, call-ASR/ytdl as alignment lands), else text replay windows (protects the base; gate = text val regression <2%). LR 1e-4 cosine-to-10% with 200 warmup — CPT, not from-scratch. audio_batch_size is small because ASR examples carry up to 1500 audio tokens each; replay_seq_len 2048 halves the text-window cost vs the 4096 pretrain context (RoPE cache still built for 4096). max_steps 20000 ~= 1.7B replay tokens + ~0.5B audio-attached tokens: the M1 pilot scale, days on the A10. Gates before any scale-up: eval_asr_cer.py CER on held-out hi/ta clearly improving; text val within 2% of base.
